reviews.author: Mihaita, România
reviews.title: Foarte bine!
reviews.text: Foarte frumos apartamentul. Aveai tot ce-ți trebuie.

reviews.author: Yanica, Bulgaria
reviews.text: Хареса ни тишината, свежият въздух и удобствата на апартамента

reviews.author: Septimiu
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Silver Mountain, an apartment complex nestled in a beautiful valley surrounded by forest. There is a direct bus connection to the slopes. The apartment was nicely divided across two floors, offering increased privacy and a cozy chalet-like ambiance. The host has been proactive and genuinely supportive.

reviews.author: Alexandru
reviews.text: Un apartament excelent cu tot ce iti trebuie si terase cu vedere la padure. Recomand cu caldura si pentru sederi mai lungi.

reviews.author: Alexandra, Germania
reviews.title: Cool apartment for a vacation in the mountains.
reviews.text: The apartment was very clean, spatious and had everything we needed. Good coffee, big terrace and a bathroom for every room.

reviews.author: Jaspal, Germania
reviews.title: Kurund knackig: Wenn Du keine Probleme willst, dann vertraue mir und buch einfach! 😴
reviews.text: We are all very excited about this apartment and can highly recommend it! Very beautiful and modern furniture, the combination of historical/modern furniture gives it a great touch! Like the cherry on top! The owner was always and immediately available and on the spot when we needed his help! Respectful and humane behavior from this cool guy! 😁

reviews.author: TrainPilot Jay
reviews.text: Rooms are all clean and shiny! The kitchen has more to offer than my own at home! 😂❤️
